description: "Breton Folk: An Artistic Tour in Brittany" by Henry Blackburn is a travelogue complemented by illustrations, written in the late 19th century. This work offers readers an insightful exploration of Brittany, capturing the region's landscapes, local customs, and the distinctive characteristics of its people, rather than focusing on historical events or the famed antiquities.
